title: NegSpA-AI deep learning aids diagnosis of HLA-B27-negative axial spondyloarthritis
summary: A deep learning network on sacroiliac joint MRI and clinical features reached AUC 0.878 (internal, n = 72), 0.870 (external, n = 54) and 0.815 (prospective, n = 87), above a junior rheumatologist. Assistance raised junior readers' accuracy by 7.4-11.5%. Training was retrospective with small test sets and wide confidence intervals at two hospitals in China.
ai_technology: NegSpA-AI deep learning network on multi-sequence MRI and clinical features
organization: Third Affiliated Hospital of Southern Medical University

evidence.tested: Internal, external and prospective test sets plus a six-reader study.
evidence.unknown: Reader-gain confidence intervals and larger validation; full text not reviewed.
